pair.title: Pair your first OldPhoneKiosk panel

error.waiting_for_phone: Waiting for the phone/tablet to enter the code and connect. Leave this screen open, enter the code in the app, then press Submit again.
error.not_connected: The code was used or expired, but the phone/tablet is not connected yet. If needed, restart the flow to get a new code.

abort.already_configured: OldPhoneKiosk is already configured. Add more panels from the integration page or remove the existing entry first.
